address: 28 Mu 4, Rangsit - Nakhon Nayok Road, Rangsit, Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani, 12110, Thailand
bio: For over 120 years, this no-frills kitchen in a wooden house on a main road has been dishing up intensely flavourful, comforting Thai fare. Don't miss the fish cake, made from authentic spotted featherback fish and heavenly spiced, served with the sweet house-special dipping sauce....
